title.zh: 三视图 · 三张影子拼回立体
title.en: Three Views · Three Shadows Rebuild a Solid

description.zh: 积木的主视图、左视图、俯视图三图对齐可还原立体；只有两个视图时可能有多种堆法。仅限 3×3 格、每格最高 3 块的方块堆。
description.en: Front, left and top views lined up rebuild a block stack; two views alone can leave several stackings. Limited to 3×3 squares, up to 3 blocks each.

reason.zh: 三视图分别丢掉一个方向的信息（深度、宽度、高度），像把位置向量投影到三个坐标平面上。
reason.en: Each view discards one direction (depth, width or height), like projecting a position vector onto three coordinate planes.

title.zh: 为什么两个视图不够，要三个？
title.en: Why are two views not enough, and why do we need three?
